strings.Strata runs entirely on your Mac. The se: Strata runs entirely on your Mac. The search index, summaries and AI features are local: no accounts, no tracking, no cloud. Its file index, content index and history are encrypted on disk with a key in your keychain. And a folder you browse can't run its own code just because you looked at it: Strata switches off the git features a downloaded repository could use to do that. It only goes online to check for updates (its own, if you allow it, and other apps' when you ask it to) and to the servers you connect to. Containers' and servers' files are read as you browse and cleared when Strata quits; SFTP logs in with your own SSH setup, and an S3 secret key stays in your keychain.
